question: When does a constructor run?
answer: When you make an object with new
incorrect_1: When you call it like a method

question: Which are true about constructors? (select all that apply)
answer: They have the same name as the class
answer_3: They run when you say new

question: A class has no constructors. Can you do new Duck()?
answer: Yes, the compiler adds a default no-arg constructor
incorrect_2: Only if Duck has instance variables

question: Duck only has public Duck(int size). Does new Duck() compile?
answer: No, the compiler only adds a default constructor when you write none
incorrect_1: Yes, the compiler adds it anyway
incorrect_3: Yes but it prints an error

question: Which pairs of constructors can be in the same class? (select all that apply)
answer_2: Duck(int size, String name) and Duck(String name, int size)
